system.description:
DRUID INSIGHT PLANT UTILITY
Druid Specialist Spell
Cast 1 minute (somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets 1 living plant rooted in the surrounding area

You place your hand against a tree, bush, grass, fungus or other rooted living growth and allow your awareness to spread briefly through it and the surrounding soil.
The plant does not speak. Instead, you perceive traces of recent disturbance recorded within its movement, roots, broken fibres, displaced soil and Verdant resonance.
Select one of the following questions concerning events within 30 feet of the plant during the previous hour:
Did one or more creatures of Small size or larger pass through this area?
What general direction did the most recent such creature or group travel?
Was significant bloodshed or violence committed nearby?
Was the surrounding vegetation recently burned, poisoned, cut or otherwise deliberately damaged?
Has an obvious unnatural or magical disturbance affected the local living environment?
What was the approximate size of the largest creature to pass nearby?
The answer is truthful but limited to information the local vegetation could reasonably retain.
Green Witness does not identify individual creatures, reveal names, read thoughts or reproduce conversations.
A plant that was not present when the event occurred cannot reveal information about it.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Ask one additional question.
+2 PP: Increase the period examined to 8 hours.
+2 PP: Increase the period examined to 24 hours.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
